reviewer.disclosed_residual: Sock-puppet authorship and captured independence still survive. Self-authorship is identifier equality against CaseSetProvenance.authors; a publisher who registers a case set under a distinct author_id they control, or who adds a rubber-stamp co-author_id, is not flagged. Independent reproduction is executor_id != publisher_id plus a metric inside tolerance; a publisher-controlled lab under another executor_id on publisher hardware still counts. The defence has no organizational-identity graph and does not require a distinct environment class from the original claim.
